decisions.reason: As a core bread product with an established place on its own page and no visible sign of underperformance, management would likely continue it rather than reverse a routine extension of the main range.
This publicly emphasized flagship stollen has strong reputational backing through its gold medal and therefore carries the strongest commitment pressure to remain in the assortment.

Although it is a more niche rye variant and could be rationalized if the bread range is streamlined further, its fit with existing baking capabilities and the prior decision to back it still favor continuation.

The marzipan stollen is somewhat vulnerable because it is seasonal and sits next to a stronger flagship stollen, but management would still tend to preserve it as a close-to-core festive line after already investing in its launch.

Because the firm publicly framed this ancient grain bread as a new 'Meisterstück' and it matches artisanal, traditional bakery positioning, management is likely to persist with it absent clear failure evidence.
